# LenovoDiagnosticsDriver.sys ![:inline](/images/twitter_verified.png) 

### Description

Lenovo Diagnostics versions before 4.45 are affected by CVE-2022-3699. Public exploit research documents FILE_ANY_ACCESS IOCTLs 0x222010 and 0x222014 in LenovoDiagnosticsDriver.sys that map caller-selected physical addresses and copy values from or to mapped memory. These arbitrary physical-memory read and write primitives allow a low-privileged local user to execute code with elevated privileges.
- **UUID**: 81a73e57-2e92-4d21-97d3-1c21eb4c3aea
- **Created**: 2023-01-09
- **Author**: Michael Haag
- **Acknowledgement**: Mike Alfaro, fluffycats31 | [alfarom256, @fluffycats31](https://twitter.com/alfarom256, @fluffycats31)

### Commands

```
sc.exe create LenovoDiagnosticsDriver.sys binPath=C:\windows\temp\LenovoDiagnosticsDriver.sys type=kernel &amp;&amp; sc.exe start LenovoDiagnosticsDriver.sys
```


| Use Case | Privileges | Operating System | 
|:---- | ---- | ---- |
| Elevate privileges | User | Windows |
